title: Gemini Omni is insanely valuable for creators and marketers #shorts
description:
Google just released Gemini Omni.

It’s their brand new video model…

And there’s a way of using this, not many people are talking about, that has completely changed the way I approach content.

Omni is super different than any other model because it allows extreme precision editing.

The video to video capabilities are no joke insane.

I can easily change my background like this.

I can add random elements in the scene like that.

I can even get super experimental, like turning my skin into metallic gold or completely warping the environment around me.

Now the reason all this is possible is because Omni is best in class at holding the right things consistent that you don’t want to change.

Up until now, AI video was a kind of a slot machine.

You could describe the vision in your head, but every new generation would change a few things you wanted to keep the same.

And it took so much effort and so many generations to get something good.

I can’t describe to you how powerful it is to finally have a video tool that actually does what I want every single time.

That’s why it’s being called the Nano Banana moment for video.

But here’s the real hack for using this not many people are talking about.

Some people see Omni and dismiss it because some of the demos are a bit extreme.

Crazy cartoon overlays or wild effects you might not normally use.

Instead, what I like doing, is using it to make subtle changes you might not even notice.

For example, we can slightly adjust the lighting in the room like this.

Or add an accent spotlight coming in like that.

Or even add slight dark shading on the visual like this to better show a text overlay.

These are all the smaller tweaks I’d actually want that finally work because Omni is so good at holding the base visuals consistent.

If you make content or edit videos, I strongly suggest playing with this.

It’s definitely taken a level up from anything else I’ve used.

If you want to try it out, the best place is to use it directly in the Gemini app.
#Sponsored #GooglePartner @googlegemini
